children.name: Chlamydomonas elegans
children.description: Chlamydomonas elegans is a species of freshwater green algae.

children.name: Chlamydomonas moewusii
children.description: Chlamydomonas moewusii is a species of unicellular green alga belonging to the genus Chlamydomonas.

children.name: Chlamydomonas nivalis
children.description: Chlamydomonas nivalis, commonly known as snow algae, also referred to as Chloromonas typhlos, is a unicellular red-coloured photosynthetic green alga.

children.name: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii
children.description: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii is a single-cell green alga about 10 micrometres in diameter that swims with two flagella.
